content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that iterates stations 1 through 13, constructs and loads each sta_NNNN result file, plots its first two columns in a 5-by-3 subplot layout with station labels and selected axis labels, then writes JPEG and EPS figures (lines 4-47).
entities: variables fdir_results (line 4), files (line 7), fig (line 9), wid (line 12), len (line 13), loop index k (line 17), numb (line 19), fnum (line 21), fname (line 24), and sta (lines 26, 28, 32)

equations.ref: Select current station number from configured file range.
Format station number as four decimal digits.
Concatenate result directory, sta_ prefix, and formatted number.
Load station matrix from constructed filename.
Assign NaN through a logical index derived from column 2.
Replace sta with the subplot station-label string.

unresolved: Line 28 forms an N-by-1 logical mask from sta(:,2) but applies it as a one-subscript linear index to the whole sta matrix; for a multi-column matrix this targets the first N linear elements rather than explicitly sta(mask,2), so the plotted column-2 zeros remain unchanged while corresponding column-1 entries can become NaN (lines 28, 31).
The script writes into plots_movies at lines 46-47 without creating or checking that directory, so output depends on prior filesystem state.
